title: SQL Injection in login endpoint
description: The login endpoint does not sanitize user inputs, allowing SQL Injection.
impact: An attacker can bypass authentication and extract database records.
stepsToReproduce: 1. Go to /login\n2. Submit username ' OR '1'='1\n3. Observe successful authentication.
recommendedfix: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements for database transactions.

title: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
description: The search query parameter is rendered back to the user without proper output encoding.
impact: Execution of arbitrary Javascript code in the victim's session.
stepsToReproduce: 1. Go to /search?q=<script>alert(1)</script>\n2. Observe alert box popup.
recommendedfix: Perform context-aware output encoding on all reflected user inputs.

title: Exposed Git Repository
description: The .git folder is publicly accessible over the web server configuration.
impact: Complete source code disclosure, including secret keys.
stepsToReproduce: 1. Request website.com/.git/config\n2. Observe git configuration leaks.
recommendedfix: Configure the web server to deny access to directories starting with dots.

title: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA)
description: The user profile endpoint /api/users/profile matches profile data purely using the route ID without verifying ownership.
impact: Unauthorized read/write access to any user profile by altering the numeric ID.
stepsToReproduce: 1. Login to user account\n2. Request /api/users/profile/1005\n3. Observe profile details of another user account.
recommendedfix: Implement strict token-based authorization checks to ensure the requesting user owns the ID.

title: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
description: The PDF generator utility accepts a URL to fetch images and fails to validate internal range IPs.
impact: Port scanning, internal network enumeration, and AWS metadata extraction.
stepsToReproduce: 1. Submit POST to /api/pdfgen with JSON body: {url: 'http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/'}\n2. Observe AWS metadata returned in the generated PDF document.
recommendedfix: Restrict remote URL fetching to a whitelist of allowed domains and restrict internal IP access.

title: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)
description: Password reset form lacks anti-CSRF state tracking or token verification.
impact: Account takeover if an authenticated user visits an attacker-controlled site.
stepsToReproduce: 1. Create an HTML form targeting the update password API endpoint.\n2. Lure victim into clicking a button to submit the form in their session.\n3. Observe password updated.
recommendedfix: Implement state-tracking anti-CSRF tokens or configure modern SameSite cookie flags.

title: Path Traversal in File Download
description: File download handler does not sanitize path traversal sequences from input variables.
impact: Arbitrary local file read access to sensitive configurations, such as /etc/passwd.
stepsToReproduce: 1. Request /api/files/download?file=../../../../etc/passwd\n2. Observe file contents returned.
recommendedfix: Sanitize input parameters and use path resolution checks like path.resolve() or path.basename().

title: Insecure Deserialization in Admin Panel
description: The application deserializes untrusted cookie values directly to reconstruct session data.
impact: Remote Code Execution (RCE) on the host environment.
stepsToReproduce: 1. Construct serialized payload containing system commands.\n2. Base64-encode and set it as session cookie.\n3. Request home screen and observe command execution.
recommendedfix: Avoid deserializing user-controlled input. Use safe data transfer formats like JSON.

title: Missing Rate Limiting on Login
description: The login endpoint does not restrict repetitive requests from a single IP address.
impact: Brute-force attacks against user credentials.
stepsToReproduce: 1. Send 100 automated POST requests with varying password values to /login\n2. Observe all requests processed without HTTP 429 restriction.
recommendedfix: Implement IP and user-session rate limits using a cache provider like Redis.

title: CORS Misconfiguration allowing Arbitrary Origin
description: CORS configuration returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin reflecting the requesting header without authentication check.
impact: Unauthorized cross-origin reading of sensitive session data.
stepsToReproduce: 1. Send request with header 'Origin: attacker.com'\n2. Observe response with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: attacker.com and Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true.
recommendedfix: Avoid wildcard origins or reflection of requesting origin when credentials are enabled.

title: Information Disclosure via Verbose Error Messages
description: Database queries display full stack traces and SQL query structures upon validation failures.
impact: System architecture reconnaissance.
stepsToReproduce: 1. Send a request with a syntactically invalid parameters.\n2. Observe SQL error trace output in API response.
recommendedfix: Configure error handling to return generic logs to users while storing detailed stack traces on-server.

title: Use of Outdated jQuery version
description: The client application imports jQuery v1.12.4, which has several known vulnerabilities.
impact: Client-side XSS and prototype pollution attacks.
stepsToReproduce: 1. Load frontend scripts in browser console.\n2. Query jquery version check.\n3. Reference CVE database for vulnerabilities.
recommendedfix: Upgrade jQuery dependency to the latest secure release version.

title: Insecure Cryptographic Storage of API Secrets
description: API tokens for external integrations are stored in plaintext in the config database.
impact: Integration credentials compromise.
stepsToReproduce: 1. Query configuration database.\n2. Observe plaintext keys.
recommendedfix: Encrypt sensitive integration tokens before persisting them, utilizing KMS or standard AES-GCM.

title: LDAP Injection in Directory Search
description: LDAP search queries are constructed using raw user input string concatenation.
impact: Arbitrary directory access and authentication bypass.
stepsToReproduce: 1. Input search query: * (or other LDAP filters)\n2. Submit search and observe extended directory listings.
recommendedfix: Use parameterized LDAP parameters or escape filter parameters using standard utilities.

title: XML External Entity (XXE) Injection
description: XML parser configuration fails to disable external DTDs or external entity resolutions.
impact: Local file disclosure and SSRF via external entity references.
stepsToReproduce: 1. Submit XML post payload defining external system entities.\n2. Observe file contents output in server XML response.
recommendedfix: Disable DOCTYPE declarations or external entities resolution in XML parser options.

title: Command Injection in Video Converter
description: Video upload utility calls system bash command directly passing unescaped filename parameter.
impact: Arbitrary shell command execution on server hosts.
stepsToReproduce: 1. Upload filename containing command injection separators (e.g. video;id;.mp4).\n2. Observe output of shell execution command returned.
recommendedfix: Avoid system shell commands. Use secure libraries and escape file attributes.

title: Hardcoded JWT Secret Key
description: The JWT encryption secret key is hardcoded directly inside backend server configuration variables.
impact: Encryption token forgery and authentication bypass.
stepsToReproduce: 1. Decompile backend bundle or check code repository.\n2. Extract hardcoded secret string.
recommendedfix: Use environment variables or fetch secrets dynamically from a key management store.

title: Missing HTTP Security Headers
description: Server responses lack HSTS, Content Security Policy, and clickjacking prevention headers.
impact: Clickjacking and XSS escalation.
stepsToReproduce: 1. Request web root using curl.\n2. Review headers for missing CSP or X-Frame-Options.
recommendedfix: Add standard middleware (e.g., Helmet) to set secure headers on all web server responses.

title: Broken Function Level Authorization in User Management
description: The admin user list page checks validation on client-side and doesn't verify roles on backend endpoint.
impact: Privilege escalation and member list exposure.
stepsToReproduce: 1. Log in with regular guest user privileges.\n2. Direct request GET on /api/admin/users\n3. Observe listing output.
recommendedfix: Verify user roles and permissions on the server-side controller for all admin-scoped operations.

title: Sensitive Data Exposure via Directory Listing
description: Web server is configured to list directory structures where index.html files are missing.
impact: Disclosure of private script assets and uploads folder.
stepsToReproduce: 1. Access directory root url /uploads/ without index.html\n2. Observe listing of files.
recommendedfix: Configure web server routing parameters to disable automatic index directories.
